name: lulux-eta
description: LULUX ETA — a local-first AI agent workspace for foreign trade teams
author: koko

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @lulux/server && npm run build -w @lulux/client && npm run dev -w @lulux/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lulux/server && npm run build -w @lulux/client && npm run build -w @lulux/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @lulux/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build -w @lulux/server && npm run build -w @lulux/client && npm run dist:win -w @lulux/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build -w @lulux/server && npm run build -w @lulux/client && npm run dist:linux -w @lulux/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build -w @lulux/server && npm run build -w @lulux/client && npm run dist:mac -w @lulux/desktop
